svg.text: On the web: what you get out of the box
RNAP 1.1.1 · howler.js 2.2.4 · Plyr 3.8.5 · Vidstack 1.15.7 · react-player 3.4.0 · icecast-metadata-player 1.17.13

howler.js
Plyr
Vidstack
react-player
icecast-
metadata-player
LIVE STREAMS AND RADIO

Reconnects a dropped live stream on its ownRNAP: the engine's recovery (the same conformance suite as iOS and Android). icecast-metadata-player: retry and reconnect by default (retryTimeout). Vidstack and react-player: hls.js's own fragment retries, for HLS only. No reconnect logic in howler.js or Plyr.
Built inRNAP — Reconnects a dropped live stream on its own: Built in
Nohowler.js — Reconnects a dropped live stream on its own: No
NoPlyr — Reconnects a dropped live stream on its own: No
PartialVidstack — Reconnects a dropped live stream on its own: Partial
Partialreact-player — Reconnects a dropped live stream on its own: Partial
Built inicecast-metadata-player — Reconnects a dropped live stream on its own: Built in
Internet radio titles (ICY / Icecast)RNAP reads ICY through MSE (needs CORS from the station); icecast-metadata-player parses ICY and Ogg metadata. No ICY parsing in the others.
Built inRNAP — Internet radio titles (ICY / Icecast): Built in
Nohowler.js — Internet radio titles (ICY / Icecast): No
NoPlyr — Internet radio titles (ICY / Icecast): No
NoVidstack — Internet radio titles (ICY / Icecast): No
Noreact-player — Internet radio titles (ICY / Icecast): No
Built inicecast-metadata-player — Internet radio titles (ICY / Icecast): Built in

HLS outside SafariRNAP: configureHls(Hls) with the app's hls.js. Vidstack loads hls.js itself; react-player bundles it (hls-video-element). Plyr's docs have the app attach hls.js. howler.js and icecast-metadata-player play what the browser plays.
Built inRNAP — HLS outside Safari: Built in
Nohowler.js — HLS outside Safari: No
Your codePlyr — HLS outside Safari: Your code
Built inVidstack — HLS outside Safari: Built in
Built inreact-player — HLS outside Safari: Built in
Noicecast-metadata-player — HLS outside Safari: No
Visualizer data for live streamsRNAP: audioSample events for streams read through MSE and local files. The others expose the element (or Howler.ctx), for the app's own AnalyserNode.
PartialRNAP — Visualizer data for live streams: Partial
Your codehowler.js — Visualizer data for live streams: Your code
Your codePlyr — Visualizer data for live streams: Your code
Your codeVidstack — Visualizer data for live streams: Your code
Your codereact-player — Visualizer data for live streams: Your code
Your codeicecast-metadata-player — Visualizer data for live streams: Your code
SYSTEM
Lock screen and media keys (Media Session)navigator.mediaSession in RNAP, Plyr (mediaMetadata) and Vidstack; absent from howler.js, react-player's own code and icecast-metadata-player.
Built inRNAP — Lock screen and media keys (Media Session): Built in
Nohowler.js — Lock screen and media keys (Media Session): No
Built inPlyr — Lock screen and media keys (Media Session): Built in

Noreact-player — Lock screen and media keys (Media Session): No
Noicecast-metadata-player — Lock screen and media keys (Media Session): No
Google CastRNAP and Vidstack load the Cast sender SDK; no Cast code in the others.
Built inRNAP — Google Cast: Built in

NoPlyr — Google Cast: No

The same player on iOS and AndroidRNAP's web engine is the TypeScript twin of its iOS and Android engines, held to the same conformance suite. The others are web-only.
Built inRNAP — The same player on iOS and Android: Built in
Nohowler.js — The same player on iOS and Android: No
NoPlyr — The same player on iOS and Android: No
NoVidstack — The same player on iOS and Android: No

Noicecast-metadata-player — The same player on iOS and Android: No
BEYOND STREAMING
Player UI (controls, seek bar)Plyr and Vidstack ship themed controls; react-player shows the browser's or the embedded service's. RNAP has only the output and Cast buttons.
NoRNAP — Player UI (controls, seek bar): No
Nohowler.js — Player UI (controls, seek bar): No
Built inPlyr — Player UI (controls, seek bar): Built in
Built inVidstack — Player UI (controls, seek bar): Built in
Partialreact-player — Player UI (controls, seek bar): Partial
Noicecast-metadata-player — Player UI (controls, seek bar): No
Video, YouTube and VimeoPlyr, Vidstack and react-player play video and embed YouTube and Vimeo. RNAP and howler.js are audio only.
NoRNAP — Video, YouTube and Vimeo: No
Nohowler.js — Video, YouTube and Vimeo: No
Built inPlyr — Video, YouTube and Vimeo: Built in

Built inreact-player — Video, YouTube and Vimeo: Built in
Noicecast-metadata-player — Video, YouTube and Vimeo: No
Sound effects: sprites, spatial audiohowler.js: sprites and the spatial plugin over Web Audio.
